Unlock Conditions: Defeat any Ganador (except for Maymay beginner Ganador); Crystal of Blessing will be granted upon leaving Command Center and entering any port city.

How to activate: Use Crystal of Blessing and select this blessing.

Effect: For one hour, NPC cannonfire will be avoided (same as Cannon Fire Null effect) up to a certain number of times per sea battle. The avoidance rate is related to its current rank.

Rank 1 (0-19 Crystals used): Up to 2 hits avoided per battle
Rank 2 (20-39 Crystals used): Up to 4 hits avoided per battle
Rank 3 (40+ Crystals used): Up to 6 hits avoided per battle

Note that as the description suggests, this item effect will not apply to PVP battles; additionally, certain NPCs such as Phantom Monsters (Cetus and Leviathan) do not use cannon-based attacks so this item will not protect you from them.
